dslRule:
<!id: remove.unnecessary.varargs.array.messageformat>
<!description: Remove unnecessary array creation for single argument to MessageFormat.format varargs method (varargs available since Java 5, baseline Java 8).
>
<!severity: HINT>
java.text.MessageFormat.format($msg, new java.lang.Object[] { $arg })
=> java.text.MessageFormat.format($msg, $arg)
;;
